description: This file defines the 'ImageCache' class which manages disk and memory caching of bitmap images in an Android application. It includes cache initialization, adding and retrieving bitmaps from cache, cache clearing, and utility methods related to disk cache management.

classes.name: ImageCache
classes.description: A class that handles disk and memory caching of bitmaps for Android, including cache initialization, adding, retrieving, and clearing cache entries, as well as utility methods for cache directory management and bitmap reuse.

classes.name: ImageCache.ImageCacheParams
classes.description: A nested static class representing configuration parameters for the ImageCache, such as cache sizes, cache directory, compression format, and whether to initialize caches on creation.

classes.name: ImageCache.RetainFragment
classes.description: A static nested retained fragment class used to hold and retain the ImageCache instance across configuration changes.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns an instance of ImageCache, creating and retaining it via a retained fragment if necessary.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the cache with provided parameters, setting up memory and disk caches as specified.

methods.name: initDiskCache
methods.description: Sets up the disk cache on a background thread, ensuring cache directory existence and available space.

methods.name: addBitmapToCache
methods.description: Adds a bitmap drawable to both memory and disk caches.

methods.name: getBitmapFromMemCache
methods.description: Retrieves a bitmap drawable from the memory cache.

methods.name: getBitmapFromDiskCache
methods.description: Retrieves a bitmap from the disk cache.

methods.name: getBitmapFromReusableSet
methods.description: Returns a reusable bitmap from the set of soft-referenced bitmaps if compatible with target options.

methods.name: clearCache
methods.description: Clears both the in-memory and disk caches.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes any pending disk write operations in the disk cache.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the disk cache, releasing resources.

methods.name: getDiskCacheDir
methods.description: Returns the cache directory, favoring external storage if mounted and non-removable.

methods.name: hashKeyForDisk
methods.description: Generates an MD5 hash of the key string to be used as filename in disk cache.

methods.name: getBitmapSize
methods.description: Calculates the size in bytes of a given BitmapDrawable, considering different Android versions.

methods.name: getUsableSpace
methods.description: Returns available storage space in bytes for a given filesystem path.
